handoverRunBothFolders: {to} found saved work in two places, in its own folder and in {from}'s. Open {to} with its window once to choose the work it opens, then run this again.
handoverRunBusy: {to} is already moving your saved work. Run this again once that move has finished.
handoverRunChecking: Checking the copy, file by file.
handoverRunContinueLater: Until the copy has been checked, Ctrl-C stops the move with nothing changed, and it starts again the next time {to} runs.
handoverRunFailed: {to} could not move your saved work: {detail}. Nothing has been changed, and {from}'s folder is as it was. Run this again to try once more.
handoverRunLeftRunning: {from} keeps running, and nothing has been changed. Run this again once it has stopped.
handoverRunMoved: Your saved work is in {to} now.
handoverRunMoving: Moving your saved work from {from} to {to}. {from}'s folder stays as it was, as a recovery copy.
handoverRunNoSpace: There is not enough room to move your saved work: it needs about {needed} free, and this computer has {free}. Make room, then run this again.
handoverRunNoTerminal: {to} asked it to save and stop, and it still holds your saved work. Nothing has been changed. To stop it now, run this again in a terminal.
handoverRunStillOpen: {from} is still open here, and it holds your saved work. Quit {from}, then run this again.
handoverRunStillWorking: {from} is still running work for another computer here, with your saved work open. Wait for it to stop, or restart this computer, then run this again.
handoverRunStopPrompt: Type yes to stop it now:
handoverRunUnfinished: {to} could not finish moving your saved work: {detail}. Your saved work is safe: {from}'s folder is as it was. Run this again to finish the move.
handoverRunUnsupported: This version of {to} cannot open your saved work: a newer version of {from} saved it. Update {to}, then run this again.
handoverRunWontStop: {to} asked it to save and stop, and it still holds your saved work. Nothing has been changed. Stopping it now ends it at once, without waiting for it to save.
handoverStoppingText: {from} is still running here with no window, and it holds your saved work. {to} is asking it to save and stop, then carries on by itself.
handoverWontStopText: {to} asked it to save and stop, and it still holds your saved work. Stop it now ends it without waiting. Nothing has been changed.
